nom: La Roche-Posay Effaclar BPO Multi-Target Acne Treatment

avis.texte: i never leave reviews however ive been struggling with small whiteheads and blackheads, as well as hormonal acne for months now and nothing has worked. ive been using this for less than a week now and it has already cleared up most of my redness and acne. i am very impressed and excited to see how it goes for the next few weeks
this treatment has helped my hormonal acne so much, it started to show a huge difference overnight. highly recommend!!!

I was having a terrible breakout of hormonal acne. Every morning I was waking up to a new pimple that was deep under the skin and very painful. I started applying this once a day in the morning, let it dry completely, then followed up with moisturizer and spf, and my acne was completely gone after two weeks. I love this stuff and will continue to use it as a spot treatment. Also, during those two weeks, there were some days I skipped using this treatment because it was very drying so just be careful because it's STRONG.

I previously used the Obagi Clenziderm therapeutic lotion which had benzoyl peroxide but I wasn't willing to pay that price anymore. This does the same job if not better and cleared my face up in a matter of days

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Love this product works great for my acne and the price is amazing.
